_comment: IMMUTABLE rebuttal anchor for all CIFAR-10 one-factor sensitivity sweeps (Phase 2). This IS the submitted config (Candidate A), confirmed by the author 2026-07-23 against the submitted PDF Table 2 and by exact numerical match to experiments/cifar_tables_paper.tex. Do NOT edit; vary exactly one field at a time in sweeps.
label: PnC single-block s3b0 ps25 bf0.05 (submitted)

target.code_convention: 0-indexed (stage_idx, block_idx); stages=[stage1,stage2,stage3,stage4]; stages[3][0] = first block of stage4

perturbation.direction_generation: Gaussian NxD then QR-orthonormalized (find_random_directions, pnc.py); K orthonormal rows in conv1 parameter space; sigmas=ones(K)
perturbation.perturbation_size_semantics: L2 radius (in conv1 parameter space) of each member's conv1 weight perturbation
perturbation.member_coefficient_normalization: each member coeff row L2-normalized to unit norm then scaled to radius = perturbation_scale * member_radius_multiplier

correction.mode: affine ridge least-squares (conv2 weight delta + new per-channel bias)
correction.ridge_centered_on: original conv2 parameters (solves for delta; H+lambda*I penalizes ||delta||^2 = deviation from original weights)
correction.subset_size_semantics: number of ID training images sampled for the correction/calibration set
correction.chunk_size_semantics: memory-only knob; results invariant (submitted OOD run used 1024; val block-sweep used 16)
correction.bootstrap_semantics: each of the M=50 members draws its own with-replacement resample of ~5% of the concatenated ridge calibration rows and runs an independent ridge solve

batchnorm.bn2_handling: bn2 (between conv1 and conv2) applied with frozen stats BEFORE forming ridge design features; correction fit on top of fixed bn2->ReLU output

evaluation.far_dataset_caveat: Places365 uses a 10k subset; DTD(textures) native 5640 — not identical to public OpenOOD leaderboard splits
evaluation.auroc_aggregation: unweighted macro-mean over constituent datasets (mean_auroc); concat_auroc (pooled) also stored but not headline
evaluation.fpr95_aggregation: macro-mean of per-dataset FPR95 (each at its own 95%-TPR threshold)
evaluation.probability_averaging: post-softmax probability-space mean over members (members return raw logits; softmax then mean)
evaluation.id_test_split: full CIFAR-10 test set (10000 images) -> id_metrics
evaluation.id_val_split: first 10% of CIFAR-10 train (5000 images) via _split_data(seed=99, val_split=0.1) -> val_metrics

temperature_scaling.fit_method: golden-section search over log-temperature minimizing ensemble-mean-softmax NLL
